title: Metabolite-augmented FIB-4 ML panel stages liver fibrosis in chronic liver disease
summary: Built on a discovery cohort of 3251, the panel gave rule-out sensitivity 96.3% and rule-in specificity 85.4% for significant fibrosis in chronic hepatitis B (n=729), and 93.9% and 90.2% in two MASLD cohorts (n=149 and n=155). The cohorts are retrospective.
ai_technology: Metabolomics with machine learning building the Met-FIB panel (FIB-4 parameters plus tyrosine and taurocholic acid)

evidence.tested: Discovery n=3,251; validation CHB n=729 and MASLD n=149, n=155
evidence.unknown: Retrospective cohorts; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Metabolomics plus ML builds Met-FIB panel (FIB-4 parameters + tyrosine + taurocholic acid)

source_review.scope: Abstract and author affiliations read from Europe PMC metadata for this DOI. Publisher full text not accessed.
